cd /workspace/task && python3 -c "
import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('init.xlsx')
ws = wb['Students']
for r in range(2,8):
    ws.cell(r,5).value = '=INDIRECT(\"\"&A{r}&\"!C2\"'.format(r=r)
wb.save('output.xlsx')
print('done')
"
